# Complete initial machine setup `MST`

[As built](../README.md) › Complete initial machine setup

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a new user walk through commissioning a machine -- starting Docker, storing API keys, installing harnesses, and setting crew and resource limits -- before Fabrika can process features, via screen:#/?setup.
